hardware.vram_budget_notes: 4GB tight for 4B Q4 + KV. Prefer num_ctx<=8192 (ideally 4096 for live), keep model loaded, single concurrent gen. Target peak VRAM <3.6GB.

scripted_vs_live_ledger.note: scripted is ~148x faster on same fixture; live currently fails. Root: full LLM multi-step tool loop on 1650 vs deterministic scripted path.

speedup.implication: FAST-first + live purge yields ~100x more useful jobs/hour than live-ledger spam. Target 25+ jobs/h on pure FAST.

quantization_impact.recommendation: Lock explicit qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M when present; alias qwen3.5:4b is identical quant. Never Q5+/FP16 on this host.

tradeoffs.vs_q5: Q5 needs ~3.5-4.5 GB → OOM or offload on 4GB
tradeoffs.knee: Q4_K_M is the inflection; Q3 hurts agent correctness

quantization_impact.speed: Lower quant reduces bandwidth pressure on Turing; primary latency still comes from number of generation steps, not quant alone.
quantization_impact.action: Set ETHER_PRIMARY_MODEL=qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M (or qwen3.5:4b). Measure nvidia-smi peak under direct_hard.

vllm_investigation.verdict: NOT primary path for this host (Phase 1)
reasons: GTX 1650 = Turing SM 7.5: supported for GPTQ/AWQ/GGUF/bitsandbytes but FlashAttention-2 requires SM>=8.0 (falls back)
Host is Windows native; vLLM has no official Windows support (WSL2 or community fork required)
4GB VRAM is below comfortable vLLM operating point
Agent tool loops are short, low-concurrency: continuous-batching advantage small
Integration cost high vs measured gain
vllm_investigation.when_to_revisit: Cousin hardware (>=8-12GB, Ampere+) or after WSL2 + controlled TTFT A/B.
vllm_investigation.keep: Ollama remains the locked runtime for host <=4B.

reasons: TensorRT-LLM modern support matrix prioritizes Ampere+ / Ada / Hopper / Blackwell; Turing is legacy/community
Linux x86_64 primary; Windows host would need WSL2 + full CUDA stack rebuild
Engine build + checkpoint conversion complexity high for solo host
4GB VRAM far below practical TRT-LLM operating point even with INT4
TensorRT engine / TensorRT-RTX can target SM 7.5 with limits (no FP8, limited INT8 WoQ) but that is not TensorRT-LLM serving
tensorrt_llm_investigation.when_to_revisit: Never on GTX 1650. Cousin Ampere+ Linux box only.

latency_mitigation_steps.detail: ollama keep_alive high / never unload between jobs. Cold load on 1650 costs seconds.
ETHER_NUM_CTX / num_ctx <= 8192 host-wide; 4096 for any live experiment.
Scripted/direct/tool_runtime before any live. kill_live + live_skip_ticks=36.
Honest tool order + early terminal. Avoid open live agent loops until Phase 1D green.
max_steps and per-step timeout must fit realistic wall time.
Scoreboard fields for honest backend comparisons.

targets.live_ledger_honest_pass: OPEN — Phase 1D gate (blocked until measured honest tool path with is_honest_tool_path_pass)

priority: Cap ETHER_NUM_CTX / num_ctx to 8192 or lower on host profile
Q4_K_M only — never higher quant on 4GB
Tool-runtime path avoids full agent loop when possible
Measure nvidia-smi peak during direct_hard vs live
gpu_memory_optimization.hypothesis: Most of the 148x is inference + KV + tool orchestration; scripted bypasses it. Quant is settled (Q4_K_M). Live honest pass needs tool_order + budget that fits 4GB.
